columns.name: ReviewDownTimeAtApr
columns.expression:
VAR StartDate = [Review RFI Sent 1]
RETURN
IF(
    ISBLANK(StartDate),
    0,
    VAR EndDate =
        IF(
            ISBLANK([Review RFI Rxd 1]),

            IF(
                NOT ISBLANK([EffectiveCloseDate]),
                StartDate,          
                TODAY()             
            ),
            [Review RFI Rxd 1]
        )
    VAR AprEnd = DATE(2024, 4, 30)
    VAR TruncatedEnd =
        IF(
            EndDate > AprEnd,
            AprEnd, 
            EndDate
        )
    RETURN
        IF(
            StartDate <= AprEnd,
            NETWORKDAYS(
                StartDate,
                TruncatedEnd,
                1,          
                'Holidays'  
            ),
            0
        )
)

        IF(

        )
    )
